message.content:
The problem that retrieval-augmented generation tries to address in knowledge-intensive NLP tasks is to improve the performance of large pre-trained language models by incorporating the retrieved information into their parameters, thereby enhancing their ability to store and utilize factual knowledge.

In other words, retrieval-augmented generation aims to leverage the retrieved data to improve the performance of pre-trained language models in knowledge-intensive NLP tasks, such as question answering, fact checking, and fact completion.
